name: How long does it typically take to complete a custom patio project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a custom patio project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom patio project with AKN Design Group varies depending on the scope and complexity of the design, including features like covered structures, outdoor kitchens, or intricate hardscaping. While we don't provide generic timelines, we prioritize clear communication throughout the project, offering transparent scheduling from design planning through construction and final walkthrough. Our managed process aims for efficient execution without compromising craftsmanship, ensuring that your high-end outdoor living space is completed with meticulous attention to detail and within agreed-upon phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary by scope; we provide clear communication and transparent scheduling from design to final walkthrough, prioritizing efficient execution and craftsmanship.
